description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling legacy/submission endpoints related to data assets. It provides deprecated API endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions, which internally map to data asset operations. The file includes detailed API route configurations, response schemas, and links to services managing data assets, validation, approval, and authentication, with emphasis on backward compatibility and deprecation notices.

methods.name: create_submission( payload: Dict[str, Any], current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new data asset submission from a draft, handling deprecated endpoint for backward compatibility.

methods.name: get_submission( submission_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a submission, including validation info, mapped to a data asset retrieval.

methods.name: trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Starts a validation run for a submission, acting as a backward-compatible trigger for validation workflows.

methods.name: approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles approval or rejection of a submission with signature and SoD validation, maintaining legacy interface.
